Assistant ProfessorBBM (Bangalore University), MBA (Bangalore University), Ph.D. (Management, Bangalore University) Link Dr. Sushma C. is an Assistant Professor with over 13 years of academic and industrial experience in accounts and finance. She holds a BBM, MBA, and Ph.D. in Management from Bangalore University. Dr. Sushma has published multiple research papers and presented at various national and international conferences on topics related to finance, entrepreneurship and industrial dynamics.
